belief: You do not have this alone.
world: Every post keeps a seat for someone specific in Aventura or Sunny Isles. A friend landing, a sister after work, the person who said they were not hungry. Greek hospitality on the Miami coast: stone, olive, sea light, linen, deep blue, warm white. Slide 1 is the seat being kept, a hand on it, someone about to arrive. Slide 2 is the arrival, the frozen yogurt passed between them, small in the life. The last slide is the real logo in that same place. A news spark can change who the seat is for.
imagePosts: Carousels of 3 or 4 slides. The seat, the arrival, then the real logo inside that same place. One caption that names who the seat is for.
videoPosts: One 15 second vertical scene. The seat is pulled out in the first second. Two people, a laugh, the cup passed. Fast cuts. No logo and no words.
rules: Open these files before writing a post.
Brand references are logo, cart, uniforms, and toppings.
The opening is Aventura and Sunny Isles.
Use the week's frozen yogurt idea only as a spark, then decide who the seat is for.
Name that person before you write the prompts. The slides move from the kept seat to the arrival.
The caption names who the seat is for, in one spoken line, and asks the viewer to tag them.
Match the blue, white, olive, and thick white yogurt.
The cart is optional. Use it only for a shop episode.
Image posts are carousels. Put the real logo on the last slide only, copied from the logo file.
Do not ask the video model to draw the logo or the word Títi.
Do not name other frozen yogurt brands.

images.shows: Circular blue logo. Olive branch, Títi script, Greek frozen yogurt, Greek key.
White and deep-blue frozen yogurt cart with olive branches, a topping case, and palms. Sign reads Sunny Isles.
Opening uniforms: deep-blue apron, cream hoodie, cream t-shirt, two-tone cap, blue sweatpants, all with the olive logo.
Topping bar. Ceramic bowls, pink crumble, chocolate, nuts, wooden spoons, blue and white.
